newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON MAJOR UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED ON MAJOR UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar ended Wednesday's interbank session slightly firmer on the U.S. dollar on the back of some export receipt inflows but weaker on sterling and the mark, foreign exchange dealers said.

"The Zimdollar firmed a little on the U.S. dollar basically because there were some export receipts coming in so the market was liquid but apart from that there was very little interbank trade," one dealer said.
At Wednesday's close, the local unit was quoted at 10.7425/7625 against the U.S. dollar from its 10.7550/7750 late Tuesday position.
It lost ground to sterling, against which it was indicated at 17.7767/8205 from 17.7491/7874 and ended at 6.9643/9809 on the mark from 6.9279/9444.
The local dollar was little changed against the rand at 2.2944/3012 versus 2.2941/3008.
